title: Review on progress of rare earth molecule-based functional materials in 2025
claim: Temperature can retune ligand triplet energy through restricted molecular-rotor motion, so one AIE ligand selectively sensitizes Tb(III) or Eu(III) and produces multicolor switching.
explanation: Ln-MOFs built from rotor-type AIE ligands show a self-adaptive antenna effect: heating changes rotor twist, shifts the ligand triplet, and redirects energy transfer between Tb and Eu. A related radioluminescence design uses the temperature dependence of energy transfer for self-calibrated X-ray ratiometric and thermochromic readout.
scope: Mixed Tb/Eu MOFs with rotor-containing AIE ligands, and radioluminescent ratiometric thermometers.
conditions: Temperature control of intramolecular rotor motion or of energy-transfer efficiency.
caveats: The selective sensitization pathway is reported for the cited rotor MOF, not as a universal thermometer design rule.
